subject: Monthly spend signal & purchase path confirmation
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunbeam-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up — monthly spend signal & procurement path

Hi Ethan,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking through the product use case and the sample traffic. Per our call, I wanted to capture the two quick things we discussed so we can align internally and speed up procurement:

1) Volume signal: you mentioned ~120k inference requests/day (mostly short prompts, average 60 tokens in / 180 tokens out). That maps to roughly 7–8M tokens/day inbound and ~24–25M tokens/day outbound (total ~32–33M tokens/day). Rough monthly run rate (30 days) ~= 960M tokens.

2) Budget/target price: you said the finance team expects to be in the $10k–$40k/month envelope for month-1 to month-3 pilots, with a stretch to $75k/mo if performance and cost savings justify it. You also flagged PO-based procurement above a ~$20k/month threshold.

To make this concrete, attached is a short worksheet (redwood_pricing_1M_token_v2.pdf) showing unit-econ scenarios at $500, $750, and $1,200 per 1M tokens (we usually quote per 1M tokens for elasticity). For the numbers above, a 960M token month at $750/1M is roughly $720k — clearly outside current bands, so we’ll propose a pilot configuration:

- Pilot cap: 50M tokens/month (approx $37.5k @ $750/1M)
- Canary run: 2 weeks with autoscale to 75M tokens to validate latency/SLA
- Procurement path: Purchase Order (PO) for pilot if spend > $20k/month, otherwise standard card/wire.

Next steps I suggest:
- Confirm pilot cap you’re comfortable committing to (50M vs 75M)
- Confirm PO threshold and internal approvers + expected timeline
- If PO needed, we can send an SOW + Pro Forma invoice for finance to route

Looping Rishi for alignment on discount/commit options if Sunbeam wants to lock a larger band.

Cheers,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

---

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunbeam-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@sunbeam-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — monthly spend signal & procurement path

Thanks, Mina — this is super helpful. A couple clarifications from our side:

- The 120k/day is an upper estimate for early pilot; typical day would be closer to 60–80k/day. Our averages were conservative on the call.
- Finance flagged that anything above $25k/month goes to vendor procurement and needs a PO + our legal team to review terms.
- We're interested in the $750/1M token midline you shared, but given the potential scale we need a path to tiered pricing (step-down at larger commit).

Can you send the SOW and a one-pager that explains the PO process and timelines on your side? We can push from procurement once we have that in hand.

Best,
Ethan
CTO, Sunbeam Analytics
ethan.lowe@sunbeam-analytics.com

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up — monthly spend signal & procurement path (looping in pricing)

Looping in pricing details here. Mina — short notes for the proposed pilot:

- Pilot 50M/mo at $750/1M => $37.5k/mo. We can offer a one-time 15% introductory credit for first 30 days to help get them started (reduces month-1 to ~$31.9k).
- If they commit to a 6-month reserved band of 250M tokens/mo, we can provide step-down pricing to $520/1M on committed tokens.
- PO process: standard Net 30. For pilots below $25k we accept credit card; above that we require PO + signed SOW.

Attaching a quick slide that outlines the PO/finance flow and the sample SOW for PO routing (redwood-PO-process-slide.png).

-Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---

From: Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@sunbeam-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunbeam-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — monthly spend signal & procurement path

Appreciate the clarity. Confirming procurement playbook on our end:

- Budget band: for a pilot we have an approved window up to $40k/mo with VP approval. Anything above $40k requires a business case and a longer review (2–3 weeks).
- PO threshold: anything > $25k/month requires a PO and the legal team to review vendor terms (we can fast-track with standard MSAs).
- Timeline: we can sign an SOW and issue a PO in ~7 business days once we receive the SOW + invoice.

For next steps, please send the SOW and your suggested pilot cap. If we lock 50M/mo with the intro credit you mentioned, we should be able to approve within the pilot window and issue a PO.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Procurement, Sunbeam Analytics
olivia.tran@sunbeam-analytics.com

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan.lowe@sunbeam-analytics.com>, Olivia Tran <olivia.tran@sunbeam-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — monthly spend signal & procurement path — SOW & next steps

Thanks all — great alignment. Confirming the plan from Redwood: 

1) We will prepare a short SOW for a 30-day pilot at 50M tokens/month with a 15% introductory credit on month-1.
2) Pricing on the SOW will show the $750/1M baseline and an illustrative step-down note for longer-term commit (we will not lock step-down in the pilot SOW).
3) If Sunbeam signs the SOW and issues a PO (required because pilot is > $25k/mo), our finance team will issue a Pro Forma invoice and we’ll aim to start the pilot within 5 business days of the PO.

Attached are the two files we discussed: redwood_pricing_1M_token_v2.pdf and redwood-PO-process-slide.png. I’ve also created a HubSpot opportunity and linked the SOW draft here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 and internal deal page https://dash.redwood.ai/deals/DEAL-4382.

Action items:
- Olivia: confirm VP approval for $40k pilot cap OR approve 50M tokens/month PO path (we understand $40k cap might require a shorter pilot cap).
- Ethan: confirm whether to start with an expected daily traffic of 80k/day or give us the 120k/day headroom for autoscale testing.
- Rishi/Marissa: I’ll need an SOW + Pro Forma invoice prepared by EOD tomorrow so procurement can begin.

If you want, I can set up a 20-min session tomorrow to walk procurement and finance through the SOW and invoicing flow.

Thanks,
Mina
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
